generation.prompt:
Create a polished 2D PIXEL-ART COMBAT VFX ART-DIRECTION BOARD for the tower-defense game CORE GUARDIAN. This is a STATIC VISUAL APPROVAL SHEET, not a final animation spritesheet.
Image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE: reuse the recognizable short gray-armored soldiers with muted red fabric, blue/brass repaired magical machines and cyan crystal core. Image 2 is a CURRENT GAME SCALE / bright stone path reference. Do not redesign the existing units or ground or add new gameplay.
World: repaired ruined stone fortress with new steel/brass reinforcements and crystal engineering, daylight, compact readable chunky pixel clusters. No sci-fi lasers, organic monsters, blood, gore, loot dropped on the floor, huge explosions, soft bloom or painterly blur.
Layout: high-resolution landscape board, exactly a 3 by 3 GRID of 9 clearly numbered panels on muted charcoal slate background, equal generous gutters. In every panel show the isolated NEW EFFECT ART large on the left and a small IN-CONTEXT example on a bright desaturated gray stone patch on the right. The effects must look like 2D sprites in the same oblique/topdown view as references. Crisp square pixel edges, small controlled palette, clean silhouettes, no gradients. All effects compact, preserving feet and contact shadows in context. A label at the top of each panel must read exactly:
row 1: "1 ENGINEER SHOT", "2 SINGLE SHOT", "3 MULTI SHOT"
row 2: "4 ENEMY HIT", "5 ENEMY DEATH", "6 SPEED BUFF"
row 3: "7 TOWER BUFF", "8 CORE HIT", "9 GOLD GAIN"
Panel specifics:
1: warm gold/offwhite small engineer bolt, distinctive blunt tip and tiny crystal center; arrowlike direction readable without a long trail.
2: cyan/ivory narrow precise crystal-engineering projectile for single tower, tiny brass collar.
3: short cyan/blue chunky shot for multi tower; show THREE SEPARATE SHOTS directed at three tiny soldiers in context, NO SPLASH EXPLOSION.
4: small white/cream impact flicker and restrained sparks at a gray armored soldier's torso, do not redraw its body.
5: modest common defeat/removal effect from subdued armor gray chips and a few muted red particles, NON-GORY, no dramatic full-screen cloud.
6: compact AMBER speed-buff target marker near a soldier, shield/weapon and feet remain readable; speed icon must be distinct from attack buff.
7: compact CYAN attack-support marker near the attacking tower, no engineer/player receiving it; preserve tower base and shadow.
8: cyan core in brass steel holder, restrained white/red edge flash indicates core damage while crystal stays cyan, preserve base/shadow.
9: small brass/gold reward indicator badge with a plus-shaped highlight and tiny upward sparkle, NO dropped coin or collectible, NO numerical text or fake font specimens.
Only isolated key-look stills, no frame counts, timing, pixel resolution claims or animation direction decisions. Do not include damage numerals: actual licensed-font comparison will be a separate artifact.
Consistency: all nine panels must be present, no duplicate or missing category. Effects are the hero, reference characters secondary. Readability over spectacle.
Top title exactly "A / RESTRAINED CRYSTAL LIGHT".
Direction A: refined MINIMAL crystal-light shapes. Tiny bright diamond/prism projectiles with extremely short 2-pixel implied trail. Hit is a small four-point glint. Death is four or five quiet gray/red shards. Speed buff uses two small amber upward chevrons. Tower buff uses a small cyan faceted prism badge above the mechanism, not a floor circle. Core hit is a thin interrupted white/red contour. Gold badge is a tiny brass lozenge and a plus sparkle. Fewest particles of the three options, clean simple outlines.
